verdict.rationale: Sentry has a public pricing page describing plan tiers and included features (e.g., solo dev plan, SAML/SCIM for higher tiers) without requiring a sales call for entry-level plans, but the evidence pack shows no actual per-signal/per-unit unit pricing figures (e.g., cost per error, per transaction, per span) that would let an SRE model costs precisely. Missing for 10: published per-unit rates for events/transactions/spans, evidence that enterprise-tier costs are also transparent without sales contact, and any independent confirmation that predicted costs match actual bills.
